text:
7 hours ago Redding neighbors are giving away some very useful free items this week, from home appliances to a powerful laptop. If you need to upgrade your kitchen or computer, these might be a big help.
FREE Whirlpool Electric Stove & White 6-Drawer Dresser — Delivery Only Item: Whirlpool electric stove and white 6-drawer dresser
Condition: Gently used, described as in good condition
Location listed: Quail Ridge, Redding, CA (items are currently in Utah )
Source: nextdoor.com
The owner is offering both a Whirlpool electric stove and a white 6-drawer dresser at no cost. Both pieces are said to be gently used and in good shape, ready for a new home.
These are delivery only — no pickup is available. The items themselves are free , but there is a delivery fee that depends on your location. The poster says they will share the full delivery cost before any payment is requested, and the agreed delivery fee must be paid in advance to avoid last-minute cancellations.
If you’re considering this offer, be sure you’re comfortable paying a delivery fee upfront and confirm all details with the poster on Nextdoor.

FREE LG Refrigerator & Sofa — Delivery Only Item: LG refrigerator and sofa
Condition: Gently used, described as in good condition
Location listed: Quail Ridge, Redding, CA (items are currently in Utah )
Source: nextdoor.com
This neighbor is giving away an LG refrigerator and a sofa , both described as gently used and in good condition.
Like the stove and dresser above, this is delivery only — no local pickup . The items are free , but you must pay a delivery fee based on your location. The poster says they will tell you the exact fee before any payment , and the delivery fee is paid in advance once you confirm.
Make sure you’re okay with paying for delivery upfront, and ask all your questions through Nextdoor before you commit.
